parameters.content:
## Security Deposit Disposition - one lease per execution
Replaces Relay Automation A (interest + deadline) and B (disposition document), 09-02-2026.

- Called by the parent with {leaseId}. Never runs on its own.
- Status field = Leases.Security Deposit Disposition (%%VAO::FLD::Leases::Security Deposit Disposition%%): Prepare -> Awaiting Approval -> Statement Sent | Changes Requested | Needs Attention. Full / Partial are set by the Airtable automation when the Return task is completed. Withheld is manual.
- Refuse-to-guess: no state row, missing rate year, no template ID, no leasing folder, $0 held -> Slack alert + Needs Attention.
- Deposit Decision is DERIVED from the deductions (Full Return when $0, else Partial Return). Tenant-owes = Partial with $0 back.
- Interest: pro-rated per calendar year, days/365, [accrual start, move-out). Accrual start = Interest Last Returned, else Lease Start Date.
- Send-and-wait pauses THIS execution until you answer in the approval thread. Approve is ONE click; Request changes opens a second wait that collects the note. Both are buttons - a plain thread reply is not heard.
- After approval: tenant email (%%VAO::VAR::AGENT_NAME%%, PDF attached, BCC steph) + a Return security deposit task with the math, Amount Owed and Deadline (so the money-owed chase covers it).
- Email copy lives on the Automations row (Email Subject / Email Template). Placeholders: {FirstName} {Address} {Unit} {MoveOutDate} {ReturnAmount} {OwedAmount} {Interest} {Deductions} {Held} {Deadline} {ResultBlock} {ReturnLine}
- Slack channel lives in the Config node.
